issues.title: Main experiments lack a matched-compute comparison with the strongest baseline

evidence.quote: We compare against A and B under our default training budget.

evidence.note: Checked pages 8-9 and Table 1; no matched-compute comparison or FLOPs table was found.

issues.resolution_note: The author accepts the gap and plans a matched-FLOPs comparison, but the current paper still lacks it.
issues.meta_note: The author accepts the missing matched-compute comparison and promises it in the revision, but the current paper still lacks it. The issue stays open for the current version.

issues.title: Variance, seeds and significance are not reported

evidence.note: Checked pages 8-9, Table 1 and the surrounding text; no std, confidence interval, seed count or p-value was found.

issues.resolution_note: The author accepts the point and plans three seeds with variance, but no variance is reported in the current paper.
issues.meta_note: The author accepts the variance gap and promises three seeds with standard deviation in the revision; the current paper still reports point estimates only.
